preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 5.
The length of each string S must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string S must be a lowercase letter.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of positions where a character can be inserted to make S a palindrome, followed by a newline.
The count of valid insertion positions must be non-negative.
